b1-review-4.R4.1 A birthday dinner:
Ana: Happy birthday, Danny! Sorry I'm late. And sorry again about Friday.
Danny: Don't worry! Thanks for the cake. It looks amazing.
Ana: I had it made at the bakery near the hospital. It's chocolate.
Bruno: Hi everyone! Sorry, I'm late too. My plane was supposed to land at six, but it was forty minutes late.
Danny: And then the traffic?
Bruno: Of course. Because of an accident on the highway, the taxi took over an hour. I was about to get out and take the subway!
Mrs. Lima: Well, you're all here now. Ana, how's your new kitchen?
Ana: Finally finished! We had new cabinets put in, and Danny helped us paint the walls. And this time Marcos didn't try to fix anything himself.
Bruno: Speaking of fixing things... the kitchen faucet here is leaking again. It needs fixing.
Mrs. Lima: I know, I know. I'm having it fixed on Tuesday.
Ana: So, Danny, how does it feel to be a year older?
Danny: Strange! I wish my mom were here. And I wish I could have her lasagna tonight.
Mrs. Lima: Why don't you call her after dinner?
Danny: Good idea. She'll be waiting for my call anyway.
Bruno: So what are your plans? Are you staying in São Paulo?
Danny: I was going to go home in July, but now I'm thinking of staying until the end of the year.
Ana: Then how about a trip to the Pantanal before you go?
Bruno: It's worth it! My uncle took me there when I was a kid, and I saw a jaguar.
Mrs. Lima: And the new restaurant on our street is said to be wonderful. I suggest we all go there next weekend.
Bruno: I can't. I'll be working on a big project all weekend.
Ana: And I'll be working nights again. How about the weekend after?
Danny: That works for me! Now... who wants cake?

b1-review-4.R4.3 Dialogues:
Narrator: Dialogue one.
Mechanic: Good morning. What can I do for you?
Carol: Hi. My car needs checking. The brakes are making a strange noise.
Mechanic: OK, we'll take a look. Your tires need to be changed, too.
Carol: Can I have it done today?
Mechanic: Sure. It'll be ready at four.
Narrator: Dialogue two.
Bruno: How about going to the beach on Saturday?
Danny: I'd love to, but I'll be working. I have two tours.
Bruno: Then I suggest we go on Sunday.
Danny: Sunday works for me. But it's worth leaving early, because of the traffic.
